about: Word timing of the film without the lyric text. tools/lyrics.py rebuilds the timeline from this and your LRC: a line's text is LRC line `id` (after the patches below), its words are the spans.

patches.why: word-order correction made for the word alignment (the LRC keeps LRCLIB's order)

skeleton.title: world.execute(me);
skeleton.method: HDEMUCS vocals; MMS_FA and Whisper medium.en forced alignment; bounded LRC search; median of model families
skeleton.timing_note: These are acoustic alignment estimates, not frame-accurate human-verified onsets. End is approximate; use start for reveal.
